paragraphs.text: Aretopolis is the capital city on the plane of Kephalai .
Aretopolis was well known for its Sanctum of Stars , a famed museum known even on other planes , where artifacts such as the Dragon Scroll was stored.

Aretopolis was where Chandra Nalaar stole the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars. After it was retrieved by Jace Beleren , Chandra returned and stole the scroll a second time, accidentally causing the entire building to collapse after she used her explosive magic.
